text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. You were working yourself to 
the bone again, weren't you? Even if it's 
just a short break, take them often. If 
you ruin your health, everything goes down 
the drain.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me? ...Are you worried about me, by 
any chance? Don't worry, I'm properly 
cooling down.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"During morning training, after the 
lunchtime perimeter run, during regular 
training of course, during self-training, 
after night strength training—oh."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, you're right. Let's both be 
careful not to overdo it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep running with all my 
might from here on out. —So that I can win 
everything!
